chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about the muhrim smelling rayhan. He said: "No."
It was said: "What about the fasting person?" He said: "No."
It was said: "May the fasting person smell perfumed compound and incense?" He said: "Yes."
It was said: "How is it lawful for him to smell perfume but not smell rayhan?" He said: "Because perfume is a sunnah, while rayhan is an innovation for the fasting person."

key_terms.الرَّيْحَانَ: fragrant herbs such as basil; here, something prohibited to smell in this context
key_terms.الْغَالِيَةَ: a perfumed compound or fragrance mixture
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Can a fasting person smell perfume or basil according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal ruling from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام regarding what a fasting person and a muhrim may smell. It distinguishes between perfume, which is treated as sunnah, and rayhan, which is described here as a bid'ah for the fasting person.
